commands.note: Curated common APT syntax is targeted for Ubuntu 26.04 LTS; package transactions still require native simulation and review.
DNF is not the native package manager for Ubuntu 26.04 LTS.
Ubuntu 26.04 LTS uses the util-linux 2.41 series, including the lsblk filter expression option introduced upstream in 2.40.
The curated common util-linux mount listing, read-only, type, and option syntax is covered for Ubuntu 26.04 LTS.
The curated procps-ng free human-readable, byte, and refresh syntax is covered for Ubuntu 26.04 LTS.
The curated iputils ping count, interval, numeric, and IPv6 syntax is covered for Ubuntu 26.04 LTS.
The catalog exposes stable Git global invocation syntax for Ubuntu 26.04 LTS; subcommand semantics remain separately reviewable.
